research_question: How well does the finalized FSDD causal CTC training procedure transfer to entirely new AudioMNIST speakers and recording conditions without AudioMNIST-driven tuning?

allowed_before_freeze: GitHub commit/tree metadata without audio contents

final_fit.rule: Train one new model on all six FSDD speakers; no AudioMNIST audio, labels, metrics, or metadata enter fitting or model selection.

epoch_derivation.source: selected gain_noise best epochs in the already-published six-fold FSDD LOSO experiment

final_fit.feature_statistics: computed from FSDD final-fit examples only
final_fit.checkpoint_selection: last epoch because epoch count was frozen from prior LOSO before AudioMNIST contact

external_preprocessing.failure_policy: report and stop on any file-count, filename, speaker, digit, sample-rate, channel, encoding, NaN, or empty-audio contract violation

single_digit.rule: score every official WAV exactly once

multi_digit.rule: concatenate clips only within the same AudioMNIST speaker

decoder.beam_search: not used for primary external score

required_breakdowns: accent, gender, native-speaker, age-band metadata as descriptive slices only

streaming_checks.invariant: every chunk size must produce the same final greedy text for a given waveform
streaming_checks.interpretation: chunk invariance checks implementation consistency, not recognition correctness

performance_checks.scope: preloaded and already-resampled waveform; excludes disk I/O and resampling

interpretation_bands.single_digit_exact_at_least_0_70: adequate transfer for this toy digit task; still not production ASR
interpretation_bands.single_digit_exact_0_40_to_0_70: weak transfer requiring a separately designed adaptation experiment
interpretation_bands.note: bands are descriptive labels fixed before scoring, not acceptance criteria used to hide or rerun results

stopping_and_disclosure.after_scoring: AudioMNIST becomes a contacted evaluation dataset. Any adaptation must use a predeclared AudioMNIST train/dev split and a different untouched external test source for final confirmation.
